abilities.name: Katana slash
abilities.description: A fast forward sword slash: a short-lived hit arc in front of the ninja. Supports a faster two-hit test cadence.

abilities.name: Shuriken
abilities.description: Throw a spinning shuriken forward (hold up / down to tilt it). Hits enemies and switches like the gong.

abilities.name: Enemy slash
abilities.description: An enemy sword / spear strike (hits the player). Started by a proximity reaction.

abilities.name: Oni fire bombs
abilities.description: The Oni Warlord roars and hurls a fan of fire bombs to BOTH sides (they arc down; jump / roll between them).

abilities.name: Shadow Step
abilities.description: The ninja's special: vanish in smoke and reappear up to 240 px ahead - through thin walls and paper screens.

demos.name: Full playthrough
demos.description: Plays the whole level: village fights, roll, jump + air dash, grapple, gong dart, stepping stones, ledges, wall jumps, samurai, fire traps, Shadow Step, the Oni Warlord, the scroll.
